Looking at this question about Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis (Bd) strains and their CRESS DNA mycoviral genome copy numbers, I need to recall comparative genomics data across Bd strains.

In comparative genomic studies of Bd strains (including Bd-ASIA1, Bd-BRAZIL, and Bd-CAPE), researchers identified mycoviral elements and quantified their copy numbers relative to the average gene copy number in each strain's genome. The Brazilian strain (Bd-BRAZIL), associated with the South American panzootic, was found to have the highest relative copy number of the CRESS mycoviral genome compared to the other strains examined.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
